page: UpCloud PREMIUM-8xCPU-64GB is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It features an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 8 vCPUs and 8 physical cores running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU allocation is shared, and the processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and SHA cryptography extensions. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 300 GB of local SSD storage alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core CPU performance, as evidenced by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core metrics placing in the top 10%. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and text processing also achieve top-tier results. Multi-core performance, including Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing, falls within the average range. Memory read bandwidth is average, but large-block memory write bandwidth and overall PassMark memory scores are weak, placing in the bottom 25%.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server offers a memory-optimized profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and general-purpose applications. While single-threaded execution is highly efficient, multi-threaded scaling and memory write speeds present performance tradeoffs. It is well-suited for web serving, Redis caching, and lightweight LLM inference using small models, but is less optimal for memory-write-heavy operations or larger LLM parameter models.
